(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ((d5o_hosted.work_records r
     JOIN d5o_hosted.memberships m ON ((m.workspace_id = r.workspace_id)))
     JOIN d5o_hosted.workspaces w ON ((w.id = r.workspace_id)))
  WHERE ((r.id = work_events.work_id) AND (r.workspace_id = work_events.workspace_id) AND (m.actor_user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (m.status = 'active'::text) AND (m.role <> 'field_worker'::text) AND (w.status = 'active'::text))))
